purpose: Radial exchange-only spectra of H and He for variants that separate the two GP93R changes, and for CAP exchange as a comparison with a GGA whose potential decays as -1/r.
note: The radial grid, solver targets, thresholds and SCF settings are those of inputs/radial.json.

variants.name: GP93R_CURV_X
variants.description: F_R (bounded curvature, s1 = 0.5) with the canonical density window 1e-12 to 1e-6

variants.name: GP93R_WIN_X
variants.description: canonical F_mix with the GP93R density window 1e-6 to 1e-4

variants.name: CAP_X
variants.description: CAP exchange, F = 1 + mu s ln(1+s)/[1 + c ln(1+s)], c = |A_x| mu / C1, mu = mu_PBE (Carmona-Espindola et al., J. Chem. Phys. 142, 054105, 2015), as a GGA with exact spin scaling and no clipping of s; the density below 1e-20 is replaced by its exponential continuation fitted between 1e-16 and 1e-20, because the noise of the computed tail would otherwise enter the potential through grad ln n

gga_self_check.description: the analytic GGA channel used for CAP, applied to F_PBE, against the canonical PBE path on the hydrogen density, where the canonical path is active (spin density above its 1e-12 cutoff)
